description: Aphelion - X brings NASA’s SPHEREx infrared sky survey to life. Search for a star or select a region of the sky, then compare observations over time with an interactive blink viewer. Watch moving objects and changing stars stand out, explore their infrared colours, and understand what the data reveals. Designed for curious learners and citizen scientists, Xsphere makes astronomical data accessible through visual exploration, motion tracking, and shareable views of our changing universe.
